summary: Describes Basic auth as the simplest but least secure WinRM option (base64 credentials, local accounts only), with host vars for psrp and winrm and the PowerShell command to enable it.
questions: How do I configure Basic authentication for WinRM in Ansible?
How do I enable Basic auth on the WinRM service?
Can I use Basic auth with a domain account?
Why is WinRM Basic auth insecure?

answer_card.title: Using Basic auth with WinRM
answer_card.answer_md:
Basic sends base64-encoded credentials (readable without HTTPS) and works only for **local accounts**.

```yaml
ansible_user: LocalUsername
ansible_password: Password
ansible_connection: psrp     # or winrm
ansible_psrp_auth: basic     # or ansible_winrm_transport: basic
```

It's disabled by default; enable on the host:

```powershell
Set-Item -Path WSMan:\localhost\Service\Auth\Basic -Value $true
```
